summary.text: Bobby Martin is the Democratic candidate for Alabama State Senate District 6 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Larry Stutts.
A pastor, he says his priorities include the local economy, health care access, infrastructure and support for working families.

paragraphs.text: Bobby Martin's career experience includes working as a pastor.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a North Alabama resident, pastor, husband and father who leads the Cowboy Church of Franklin County.
Martin advanced to the general election after the Democratic primary was canceled.
In the survey, he said he supports job growth and workforce development, small businesses, improved health care access in rural communities, and safer roads and infrastructure.
